assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9004 has Priority: Major. Impact map 'Inherited Field Values' section states: 'Priority: Major (inherited from TC-9004, will propagate to all created tasks)' and includes additional_fields JSON with '"priority": {"name": "Major"}'. Summary-comment.md 'Inherited Field Propagation' section states: 'Feature TC-9004 priority: Major' and 'Propagation: Major priority was inherited and set on all 5 created tasks via additional_fields.priority'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9004 has Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0 (non-empty). No Jira Field Defaults section in CLAUDE.md, so scope defaults to 'both'. Impact map states: 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0 (inherited from TC-9004; no fixVersion scope setting in Jira Field Defaults -- defaulting to "both", will propagate to all created tasks)' with additional_fields JSON '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.5.0"}]'. Summary-comment.md states: 'fixVersion scope: No Jira Field Defaults section exists in CLAUDE.md; defaulting to "both" (propagate to tasks)' and 'Propagation: RHTPA 1.5.0 was inherited and set on all 5 created tasks via additional_fields.fixVersions'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in the outputs directory and contains an 'Inherited Field Propagation' section with subsections for Priority ('Feature TC-9004 priority: Major', propagated to all 5 tasks) and Fix Versions ('Feature TC-9004 fixVersions: RHTPA 1.5.0', propagated to all 5 tasks). The additional_fields JSON is included showing both values. The impact map also has an 'Inherited Field Values' section documenting both priority (Major) and fixVersions (RHTPA 1.5.0) inheritance.
